name: Boar
summary: A wild pig that charges with its tusks and fights hardest when Bloodied.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.text: While {ref:glossary/bloodied}, the boar has {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls.

actions.name: Gore
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra {dmg:1d6:piercing} and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
